name: Arthur Wells
notable_stories: Remarried Serena Marie Nevada Trumbo (Nini) after George Francis Adams' 1920 death
Died when John Howard Adams was in 11th grade (~1963-64); Nini then moved in with John's family in San Francisco
milestones: Married Serena Marie Nevada Trumbo (m. before 1925, San Francisco, CA)
Census 1940: San Francisco, California, aged 49, born New Zealand, with his wife Serena, stepson George Adams and daughter Daphne (15)
sources: Family letters in Bill Allen’s family document
1940 U.S. census, Assembly District 22, San Francisco, California, ED 38-131, sheet 12B (FamilySearch index, accessed 2 Apr 2013)
notes: Remarried Serena Marie Nevada Trumbo in 1929 after the death of George Francis Adams (#2).
Death: ~1963-64 per this source (when John Adams was in 11th grade).
Step-father of George Francis Adams Sr. Biological father of Rosemary Wells.
CORRECTION 2026-09-23: Marriage dated before 1925 rather than about 1929: their daughter Daphne was born about 1925 (1940 census). Decision by Brendan Adams.
